description: TMAG5273A2 is a low-power linear 3D Hall-effect sensor from Texas Instruments that measures magnetic field strength on the X, Y, and Z axes. The A2 variant covers the wider +/-133 mT and +/-266 mT ranges and responds at I2C address 0x35. It also provides a die temperature reading, a calculated angle from a configurable axis pair, and a magnitude result.
